57577.commentary: (ANa) satataṃ samitan'ti sabbakālaṃ nirantaraṃ. ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ mayhaṃ upaṭṭhitam'evā'ti dasseti.

satatakārī hoti satatavutti sīlesu, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpajjo hoti, anatimānī hoti, sikkhākāmo hoti, idam'atthaṃ'ti'ssa hoti jīvitaparikkhāresu, āraddhavīriyo ca viharati.
sātatikan'ti satatakāriṃ.

57579.meaning1: continuous mode of living; constant state of being

examples.text: evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa kho, vappa, bhikkhuno cha satatavihārā adhigatā honti.

57580.meaning2: who abides in constant mindfulness and full awareness

57581.meaning1: with consistent mode of living; steadfast in lifestyle
57581.commentary: (MNa) santatasīlā'ti satatasīlā nirantarasīlā. santatavuttino'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ, santatajīvikā vā'ti'pi attho. (ANa) na santatavutti sīlesū'ti satataṃ sabbakālaṃ sīlajīvitaṃ na jīvatī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na satatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.

57582.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of satata

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito, app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ
sati kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, chasu phass'āyatanesu saṃvuto, satataṃ bhikkhu samāhito, jaññā nibbānam'attano'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito, app'eva nām'āhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ

evaṃ vutte, mahānāma, te nigaṇṭhā maṃ etadavocuṃ, nigaṇṭho, āvuso, nāṭaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.
iti ime satadhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā'ti. idam'avoc'āyasmā sāriputto.

57586.meaning1: in one hundred ways; into one hundred

examples.text: so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya
anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadatī'ti. so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya.

yathā, mahārāja, satapatto ravitvā paresaṃ khemaṃ vā bhayaṃ vā ācikkhati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yog'āvacarena paresaṃ dhammaṃ desayamānena vinipātaṃ bhayato dassayitabbaṃ, nibbānaṃ khemato dassayitabbaṃ.
sārambhaṃ nāma kipillikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, upacikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, undurānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, ahīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, vicchikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, satapadīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, hatthīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti
appamāṇo buddho, appamāṇo dhammo, appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni. ahivicchikā satapadī, uṇṇanābhī sarabū mūsikā, katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni.

57592.meaning2: (an oil) medicated for a hundred times

57593.meaning1: with a hundred marks of merit
57593.meaning2: having the signs of innumerable merits
57593.commentary: (DNa) satapuññalakkhaṇan'ti satena satena puññakammena nibbattaṃ ek'ekaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ. evaṃ sante yo koci buddho bhaveyyā'ti na rocayiṃsu, anantesu pana cakkavāḷesu sabbe sattā ek'ekaṃ kammaṃ satakkhattuṃ kareyyuṃ, ettakehi janehi kataṃ kammaṃ bodhisatto eko'va ek'ekaṃ sataguṇaṃ katvā nibbatto. tasmā satapuññalakkhaṇo'ti imam'atthaṃ rocayiṃsu.

examples.text: samantanemīni sahass'arāni ca, byākaṃsu veyyañjanikā samāgatā, disvā kumāraṃ satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, parivāravā hessati sattumaddano.
jit'indriyaṃ buddham'anomanikkamaṃ, nar'uttamaṃ kassapam'aggapuggalaṃ, avāpurantaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, dev'ātidevaṃ satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ.

57594.meaning2: of the height of a hundred men

57596.synonym: ādicca, divākara, pabhaṅkara, bhāṇumant, ravi, verocana, suriya, sūriya, harissa

examples.text: dasa disā pabhāsetvā, sataraṃsī'va chappabhā, sabbaṃ tam'antarahissanti, nanu rittā sabbasaṅkhārā'ti.

57597.meaning1: (of gold) weighing one hundred grains; (comm) with one hundred inscribed lines

examples.text: hitvā satapalaṃ kaṃsaṃ, sovaṇṇaṃ satarājikaṃ, aggahiṃ mattikāpattaṃ, idaṃ dutiy'ābhisecanan'ti.
dehi je ambapāli amhākaṃ etaṃ bhattaṃ satasahassenā'ti

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

ye'pi tattha sattā upapannā te'pi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. tassa evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā satasahassassa brahmuno sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti. so taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
